verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical 320x50 banners. In each, the attribution 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' is set in bold caps at the bottom-left, below the quote mark and to the left of the quote, so it outweighs the italic quote and confuses the reading order. The quote text is tiny, and the can is shrunk into an unrecognisable sliver against the right edge. A drops the SOLSTICE logo entirely. B keeps a logo, but as an illegible speck crammed under 'soon.', which only slightly beats losing the brand altogether.
